blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension. 2. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension. 2.

exercises.q: То-то, воображаю, будет нервничать и турнюром своим дрыгать, когда меня не найдет в ___ (беседка)!..
exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Не понимаю, чего вы пристаете… — пожал ___ (плечи) Митя.
exercises.why: «The Instrumental without С is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted.» — DLI, Lesson 30. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «The Instrumental without С is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted.» — DLI, Lesson 30.

exercises.why: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "-ее" (sometimes shortened to "-ей") to the stem of the adjective: новый — новее; красивый — красивее. In both English and Russian adjectives and adverbs have three forms, which are called degrees: positive, comparative, superlative — good, better, best; fast, faster, fastest. This comparative form is the same for all genders and the plural. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80, 82.  ·  «Memorize the following irregular comparatives»: рано — раньше, поздно — позже, редко — реже, часто — чаще, близко — ближе, далеко — дальше, много — больше, мало — меньше, хорошо — лучше, плохо — хуже, легко — легче, громко — громче, долго — дольше, высоко — выше, низко — ниже, жарко — жарче, дорого — дороже. — DLI, Lesson 82. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "-ее" (sometimes shortened to "-ей") to the stem of the adjective: новый — новее; красивый — красивее.

exercises.q: Простите за признание, но страдать и ___ (молчать / замолчать) нет сил.
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.why: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). 1. to do (to be doing) something for a period of time: *Я долго писал письмо.* — 1. to complete the action and thus to achieve a result: *Я написал письмо; вот оно на столе.*. 2. to do something habitually: *Я всегда пишу письма по-русски.* — 2. to do something once: *Ему я написал по-английски.*. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: ___ (послушать / слушать), Митя, — сказал он, — я прошу тебя в последний раз…
exercises.why: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42.

exercises.q: Я молода, ___ (хороший) собой… чего же вам еще?»
exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.

exercises.q: Выходцев вступил на аллею, в конце ___ (который) из-за молодой листвы высоких лип выглядывала «старая беседка»…
exercises.why: «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI, Lesson 53. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «"Который" in subordinate clauses agrees in gender and number with the noun it refers to in the main sentence, but its case is determined by its function in the subordinate clause.» — DLI, Lesson 53.

exercises.q: Слава богу, восемь ___ (годы) ни на шаг не отходил от нее…
exercises.why: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много, Несколько, Мало, Сколько.» — Wikibooks, «Genitive case». From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много,…

exercises.why: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.

exercises.q: Что это за ___ (письмо) получил ты сегодня утром? — спросила она.
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: «Впрочем, так разве, пойти из любопытства… — думал через ___ (полчаса) дачник.
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».

exercises.q: В это время вдруг в ___ (беседка) заглянуло женское лицо с вздернутым носиком…
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».

exercises.q: Митя ухмыльнулся и перестал глядеть с ненавистью на ___ (свой) соперника.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: В его воображении мелькнула стройная блондиночка в светло-голубом платье и с ___ (вздёрнутый носик)…
exercises.why: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: В это время вдруг в беседку заглянуло женское лицо с ___ (вздёрнутый) носиком…
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Антон Чехов, «На даче».
